notes.title: The Past Within + Rusty Lake Midweek Madness
notes.notes:
We are very excited to announce our upcoming title The Past Within:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1515210/The_Past_Within/ 

Are you ready to unlock The Past Within? Teaming up with a friend, travel through both past and future to piece together the mysteries surrounding Albert Vanderboom. Communicate what you see around you to help one another solve various puzzles and explore the worlds from different perspectives!

Official teaser trailer:

[previewyoutube=bopzNbExy1Q;full][/previewyoutube]

The Past Within is an upcoming multiplayer point-and-click adventure taking place in the Rusty Lake universe. Next to PC & Mac, the game is also coming to IOS, Android and hopefully console!

Please keep in mind that the development of this game is still in an early stage: we still have a long way to go before we can communicate a release date! Stay tuned on our social media, our blog or on Steam for more information / development logs.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/rustylake][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623373/7eb60367c1a92592a8c6307e44c5802491354ec5.png[/img][/url]

Together with this big announcement and the 5 year anniversary of our first premium game released on Steam, Rusty Lake: Hotel, we’d like to celebrate alongside all of you with a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/rustylake]50% discount on all of our Steam games[/url]! Thank you for all your love and support, we wouldn’t be here without all of you wishlisting, reviewing and sharing your enthusiasm for our games on Steam!

Thank you all for your support, stay safe and greetings from The Lake!

notes.title: The Cube Escape Collection is now available! 🎉
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33593611/cf0f6f168ff467c1a553bc23068435a1e744ffc6.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone!

We’re very excited to finally release a Collection of the first nine Cube Escape chapters on Steam to survive the end of the Flash Games era:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1292940/Cube_Escape_Collection/

We hope you will be happy to finally have all these games in one place where you can easily revisit the Rusty Lake universe and unlock all the 72 new achievements! There is also a new hint system and our translators did a tremendous job adding translations to all of them.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UTKfF1K1MUg

We are celebrating this much-awaited release with a sale, as a small thank you to all of you for the amazing support you’ve shown us over the years. When we released our first Cube Escape game, Seasons, 5 years ago we never dreamed we would attract such an amazing community. To this day we’re still blown away by your continuous support and kind words. Thank you for being such a big part of the Rusty Lake journey!

Good luck finding all the achievements and please stay tuned for future Rusty Lake updates!

Thanks for your support! The past is never dead 🦐

Rusty Lake

Important:
- We really appreciate your feedback! Feel free to leave a review in the store!
- Any bugs/glitches? Please let us know on [url=https://discord.gg/rustylake]Discord[/url] or at support@rustylake.com.
- All our games (including The White Door) are on 50% sale as well for today - please keep an eye on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/rustylake]Steam page[/url]!
- The Collection contains 9 chapters: Seasons, The Lake, Arles, Harvey's Box, Case 23, The Mill, Birthday, Theatre and The Cave. Paradox will be available separately.
- These games do not contain any new content from their original versions (besides achievements, a new hint system and translations)!

notes.title: Surreal, stylish Rusty Lake precursor Samsara Room gets free remake, is out now on Steam
notes.notes:
Fans of the gorgeously surreal point-and-click-meets-room-escape Rusty Lake adventures have another unsettling slice of narrative fancy to sink their teeth into, courtesy of a refreshed and revised version of series precursor Samsara Room, which is out now - and free - on Steam.

If you've yet to experience the Rusty Lake games, I can heartily recommend you remedy that immediately. They're wonderfully entertaining endeavours, many of which are playable free, with each deliciously sinister entry offering a largely self-contained experience but forming another piece in the series' vast, centuries-spanning narrative puzzle.

The games have grown increasingly ambitious as time has gone on, but they're ultimately casual puzzlers at their core, with just enough challenge to illicit a satisfied nod; the real joy, though, comes from their deliciously off-kilter atmosphere and the mental delights of connecting the narrative dots across 15 distinct instalments, where recurring characters, locations, and motifs drift in and out like a fever dream.
